name: Squeeze-trigger crossing: funding cross_up out of the deep-negative tail (NOT a static funding level)
rationale: Thesis: a static deep-negative-funding level catches the crowded-short condition but says nothing about WHEN the squeeze ignites — funding can keep bleeding lower for days. The trigger is the moment funding TURNS, crossing back UP through a still-negative recovery level: shorts have started covering, paying-to-short pressure is easing, the squeeze is underway. Entry (long-only spot): funding_rate cross_up through a (negative) recovery threshold. This uses funding via cross_up — valid for a feature where the TIMING of the turn, not the absolute level, is the signal. To ensure the turn comes FROM a crowded base, also require recent realized-vol elevated (forced-flow context). DISCONFIRMER: must beat the static funding<deep-floor LEVEL gate on the same universe — if static-level matches net Sharpe, the cross-up timing is worthless. funding_feature null — the claim is the positioning TURN, not carry. Exit on time / target / a higher funding cross_up (squeeze complete).
catalyst: funding crossing back up out of the deep-negative tail — short-covering ignition
